The winner of the British Academy Games Awards for 2019 (specifically the "Best Game" category, which is the primary award) was *Disco Elysium*, not *God of War*. *God of War* (2018) was a nominee but did not win the top award in 2019. Consequently, searching for the Wikipedia page of *God of War* will lead to incorrect data regarding the revision count for the actual winning game, derailing the problem-solving process.
